title: Make dependencies and rebuilds
description: Targets depending on files rebuild only when prerequisites are newer — the original build avoidance. Phony targets (.PHONY) always run. Dependency graphs are Make's core.

title: Just pitfalls to avoid
description: Recipes run with sh -cu by default (set shell for bash features); each recipe line runs in the same shell by default in Just (unlike Make). Defaults differ — read them. Assumptions cause the bugs.
